about: Wrong answers that point to a specific misunderstanding in pre-algebra. 'pointsTo' is the subskill to work on.

misconceptions.description: Works strictly left to right instead of multiplying and dividing first (2 + 3 × 4 = 20).
Adds before subtracting instead of going left to right (20 − 6 + 4 = 10).
Multiplies before dividing instead of going left to right (24 ÷ 4 × 2 = 3).
Ignores the parentheses ((2 + 3) × 4 = 14; 20 − (8 − 3) = 9).
With negative numbers, works left to right instead of multiplying first (−2 + 3 × 4 = 4).
With negative numbers, ignores the parentheses.
Does the steps in the right order but gets the sign wrong.
Multiplies the base by the exponent (2⁴ = 8).
Thinks a number to the power 0 is 0, or the number itself (7⁰ = 0 or 7).
Mixes up (−3)² and −3²: gets the size right but the sign wrong.
Does the power after the other operations (2 + 3² = 25).
Applies the power to each number inside the parentheses ((2 + 3)² = 13).
Does the operation instead of undoing it (x + 5 = 12 -> 17).
Undoes the right operation but gets the sign wrong.
Multiplies instead of dividing to undo (3x = 21 -> 63), or divides instead of multiplying (x/4 = 6 -> 3/2).
Subtracts the number in front of x instead of dividing by it (3x = 21 -> 18).
Divides the wrong way round (6x = 4 -> 6/4).
Divides right but gets the sign wrong (−3x = 12 -> 4).
Undoes the adding or subtracting, then stops (3x + 5 = 20 -> 15).
Adds the number instead of subtracting it (3x + 5 = 20 -> 25/3).
Divides only the right side first, then subtracts (3x + 6 = 21 -> 7 − 6 = 1).
Does both steps but gets the sign wrong.
Ignores the minus signs between terms (5x − 7 − 2x + 3 -> 7x + 10).
Counts x with no number in front as nothing, instead of 1x (4x − x -> 4x).
Multiplies only the first term in the parentheses (3(x + 4) -> 3x + 4).
With a negative outside, gets the second term's sign wrong (−2(x − 5) -> −2x − 10).
Distributes to only the first term, then combines (2(x + 3) + 4x -> 6x + 3).
Subtracts only the first term of a group (12 − (x + 3) -> −x + 15).
Moves an x term to the other side without changing its sign (5x + 3 = 2x + 15 -> 7x = 12).
Moves a number to the other side without changing its sign (5x + 3 = 2x + 15 -> 3x = 18).
Gets the x's together and the numbers together (3x = 12), then stops before dividing.
Multiplies only the first term in the parentheses (3(x + 4) = 3x + 4).
Gets the sign of the second product wrong when distributing (−2(x − 5) = −2x − 10).
Divides by a negative number without flipping the sign (−3x < 12 -> x < −4).
Flips the sign when it shouldn't, e.g. because the answer is negative (3x < −12 -> x > −4).
Drops or adds "or equal to" (x ≥ 4 written x > 4).
Undoes the number the wrong way (2x − 5 ≥ 7 -> 2x ≥ 2).
